title: Explode
description: Explode a column of lists into rows.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name of the column(s) to explode. If multiple columns are included they must contain lists of the same length.

parameters.name: reset_index
parameters.description: Reset the index after exploding. Default True.

parameters.name: drop_empty
parameters.description: If true, any rows that contain an empty list will be dropped. If false, rows that contain empty lists will keep 1 row with an empty value. Default False.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
